label: One definition block: the dominance frontier
section: One definition block: the dominance frontier
subgoals: Compute the dominance frontier of each block that assigns the variable
Place a phi in every block of those frontiers
Ignore the entry, whose frontier is empty

label: Iterating the frontier
subgoals: Treat every placed phi as a new definition
Add each new phi block to the worklist
Stop when no frontier adds a new block

label: Several variables and pruning
subgoals: Compute the phi set for each variable from its own definition blocks
Sum the phi counts over the variables
Filter the phi blocks by liveness for pruned SSA
